items.title: MEXC Unveils “WE SEE YOU” Brand Visual Refresh, Putting People Behind Every Trade in Focus
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 29, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, today announced a visual refresh of its brand centered on “WE SEE YOU.” The new identity shifts the focus from accounts and trading activity to the people behind them. items.title: MEXC Earnings Season Data: Nearly Half of Tokenized Stock Trading Volume Occurs Outside Regular U.S. Hours
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 29, 2026 — MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, today released stock trading data from the July-August 2026 earnings season, highlighting a continued shift in U.S. stock market participation beyond regular trading hours. During the period, 49.20% of tokenized stock trading volume took place during pre-market, after-hours, and overnight sessions, exceeding the 40.26% recorded during regular trading hours. items.title: PrimeXBT Insights: Bitcoin rallied through a rate hike; Can it rally through a bond selloff?
items.summary: By Jonatan Randin, Senior Market Analyst at PrimeXBT In mid September the setup looked bad for Bitcoin. The CLARITY Act failed in the Senate on 15 September and the Fed hiked to 3.75 to 4.00% the next day. Bitcoin (BTC) briefly traded under $75,000. A week later it was above $87,000. Then the bond market moved, and Bitcoin stopped going up.
